reviews.title: Poor Customer Service for Loss of Network
reviews.body: Phoned Lebara regarding loss of network.  Long process to get past AI and then had to repeat all info again to real person.  They have said I will have no signal until mid December & if I go through the whole phone call carry on again each month so that’s another 3 times I will get a £5 credit.  So today was 14 minutes on the phone & then repeat each month…..no you should be able to apply the credit automatically.  I will be moving to another network.  Very disappointed!

reviews.title: TERRIBLE AT HANDLING FRAUD CASES
reviews.body:
I am a long standing Lebara customer and have previously been very happy with the product and service received.
However, my e-mail and Lebara account were hacked into, and a new SIM ordered etc etc.  The hacker also changed the registered address on the account.
I have contacted customer services 3 times regarding getting this fraudulent number removed from my account and still nothing has been done.    On the 3rd call, I was told I would be sent a link to get the number removed, but as yet this has not appeared,
I asked to be put through to a dedicated fraud team and was surprised when I was told that there wasnt' one.
It seems Lebara don't take fraud very seriously.

reviews.title: No understanding of decent customer service
reviews.body:
Follow up to my previous review and how poor the customer service is for this company. Kept taking payment from my bank even though I had credit on my account yet I had to contact them every month to sort a refund. Some agents said my credit was valid some said it wasn't even though they had put it on my account.
Anyway, received a call from their retention team after my initial review on here wanting to sort it out(shame it had taken a negative review on here for that to happen) so the agent agreed to sort everything out and put a credit on my account meaning they wouldn't take any payment from my bank for 3 months however asked me to remove my review as it would help her out but I refused to as people need to know the truth, so come to monthly renewal and surprise surprise they took payment from my bank, I contact them again only to be told the credit the retention lady added to my account wasn't valid.
A PAC code and 48 hours later I have moved to a different provider and these clowns are still ringing up and leaving messages wanting to understand the problem on and the refund promised still hasn't arrived. Baffles me how they are so highly thought of.
